fields.v: Macro: Agile-V increments traceable to requirements, design, implementation, verification, approval, audit. Micro (SCOPE-V): Specify -> Constrain -> Orchestrate (inspect, summarise, plan, small slices, local checks, diff summary) -> Prove (tests, static analysis, simulation, HIL per risk) -> Evolve (feed learning back to instructions/templates/tests) -> Verify (recurring). Conversation-to-contract gate between exploratory dialogue and implementation. Task workflows for features (9 steps), bug fixes (8 steps), testing, hardware

fields.v: Synthesis and process proposal, not a benchmark; fast-moving field, point estimates may change; productivity studies and hardware benchmarks heterogeneous; framework must be validated empirically across teams, repositories, tools and hardware domains. Research agenda: do structured briefs beat conversational prompts; minimum useful repository instructions; independent agentic test generation and defect escape; which task classes benefit or are slowed by overhead; evidence bundles vs verification debt; hardware evidence quality
